faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions about websites for local businesses

questions.question: We already appear on Google Maps — why do we need a website?
questions.answer: Google Maps shows where you are. A website shows who you are. It presents your services, prices, photos, and brand professionally. Customers are more likely to choose a business with a website over one without.

questions.question: We already use Bokadirekt — why add a website?
questions.answer: Booking platforms are great for scheduling, but they don't present your business. A website increases trust, showcases your work, explains your services, and makes customers more confident before they book. Think of it as your digital storefront.

questions.question: Is this SEO-heavy?
questions.answer: No — it's presentation-focused. While we include basic SEO, the main goal isn't to rank #1 on Google for every search. It's to look professional and trustworthy when customers find you through any channel — Maps, social media, word of mouth, or search.

questions.question: How fast is delivery?
questions.answer: Most websites are delivered within 3–4 days. Simpler sites (up to 3 pages) typically take 4 days, while more complex sites (up to 6 pages with custom branding) can take up to 2 weeks. You'll get an exact timeline after we discuss your needs.

questions.question: Do I need new software or subscriptions?
questions.answer: No. We integrate the booking method you already use — Bokadirekt, Calendly, calls, or a simple form.

questions.question: What if I don't have professional photos?
questions.answer: No problem! We can work with smartphone photos and offer professional photo editing as an add-on service. Good photos help, but they're not required to get started.

questions.question: Can I update the website myself later?
questions.answer: Yes! With the optional maintenance subscription, we can help you with updates. Or we can show you how to make simple changes yourself. The choice is yours.

questions.question: What if I don't have a domain or already have one?
questions.answer: If you don't have a domain, we can help you register one (typically 100–200 SEK/year). If you already have a domain, perfect! We'll connect your new website to it. Either way, we'll guide you through the process.

questions.question: What happens after the website is live?
questions.answer: Your website is yours! You can choose the optional monthly maintenance plan for hosting, updates, and support, or manage it yourself. We're here to help either way.
